SafeMath.safeAdd: adds two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: subtracts two uints and requires no underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv: divides two uints, requires non-zero divisor.

ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval: external contract callback invoked by approveAndCall.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership, guarded by onlyOwner; sets pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership: requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalizes transfer.
IbkToken constructor: sets metadata, supply and initial holder balance, emits Transfer.
IbkToken.totalSupply: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
IbkToken.balanceOf: returns balances of the queried address.
IbkToken.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safe math.
IbkToken.approve: sets allowance for spender from msg.sender.
IbkToken.transferFrom: moves tokens using allowance decremented from msg.sender.
IbkToken.allowance: returns remaining allowance for spender.
IbkToken.approveAndCall: sets allowance then calls external spender contract receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
Owner-only rescue function performing an external ERC20 transfer from this contract.
Unchecked arithmetic c = a + b in safeAdd, validated by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic c = a - b in safeSub, validated by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic c = a * b in safeMul, validated by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic c = a / b in safeDiv, validated by require(b > 0).
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in IbkToken.totalSupply.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) with attacker-controlled target contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied token contract.
